Train the brain

This page trains the game's brain the way the night list does - the same search, the same fights, the same grade against the untrained brain, chance and the stock brain, and the same files. It is held to the night's trainer by node tools/traincheck.mjs: the same settings give the same brain, number for number, and the page's threads give the same brain as one thread.

One difference, measured: this browser and Node (where the night list runs) work out a few fights differently around the tenth digit. A short run still ends on the same brain; over a long run those differences can grow, so a brain trained here is the same game's fights and the same grade, not the night's brain number for number.
